sourceText.he: אֲפִילּוּ תֵּימָא רַבִּי יְהוֹשֻׁעַ, וְדִלְמָא כְּוָתִיקִין. דְּאָמַר רַבִּי יוֹחָנָן: וָתִיקִין הָיוּ גּוֹמְרִין אוֹתָהּ עִם הָנֵץ הַחַמָּה.

positions.claim: the mishna can follow R' Yehoshua too, being addressed to those who practise like the vatikin
positions.basis: R' Yochanan's report that the vatikin finish Shema at sunrise

positions.claim: the vatikin would finish the Shema exactly at sunrise
